items.title: Billy Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: I can remember, one of these dates I can remember the studio and Ralph Sharon sitting at the studio.

ctx.x: Okay. Can you remember recording these records? It’s interesting that Basie —
